question: The first shape changes in some way to become the second shape. Which option replaces the question mark? (Pro Genius Analogy Q3)
facts: Count the lines from the outside in. In figure 1 the outer two lines swap their corner style (square and round) and the inner two lines swap too, while thick and thin stay where they are. In figure 3 the 2nd line has a gap on the right arm and the 3rd line has a gap on the left arm, so swapping line 1 with line 2 and line 3 with line 4 moves the right gap to the outer line and the left gap to the innermost line, which is option 1. Option 2 is tempting, but it only swaps the outer pair; its left gap is still on the 3rd line.
rel: Number the nested lines 1 to 4 from the outside and list each line's feature (gap, corner, thickness). Then check pair by pair which features moved.
